turns.text: Hello. I am SaharaAI... are you safe where you are right now?
Yes, I am at a community centre.
I want emotional support. I feel scared after what happened and I don't want to give all the details.
You can share as much or as little as you want...
हाँ, मैं सुरक्षित हूँ। मुझे कानूनी जानकारी चाहिए। शिकायत कैसे करें यह समझ नहीं आ रहा।
सत्यापित डायरेक्टरी से DEMO DATA दिखाया जाएगा। कानून का आविष्कार नहीं किया जाएगा।
Main abhi safe hoon. Mujhe bahut darr lag raha hai, unhone dhamki di thi, lekin details nahi dena chahta.
Theek hai, koi pressure nahi. Main sun raha hoon.
